The '''Agora system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agora]].
